purpose: Enforce controller-scoped, exactly-once permit consumption and bounded consumed-identity bookkeeping with an explicit exhaustion result, independent of the session table.
interfaces: try_consume(ControllerId, PermitId, SessionId, Result& out) -> Result (atomic check-then-insert)
capacity() const -> std::size_t; size() const -> std::size_t
outputs: Result (Ok, SessionAlreadyConsumed, PermitAlreadyConsumed, CapacityExhausted) and boolean set-membership queries.
state: Controller-scoped consumed-permit-identity set bounded by max_consumed_permits.
Controller-scoped consumed-session-identity set bounded by max_consumed_sessions.
Both sets guarded by the owning manager's single std::mutex; non-copyable and non-movable.
errors: SessionAlreadyConsumed: session identity already bound to a consumed permit.
CapacityExhausted: consumed-identity bookkeeping is full and consumption is refused.
invariants: Check-then-insert is atomic: no partial insertion on any failure.
Session key is checked before permit key, so a changed-nonce replay is reported as SessionAlreadyConsumed.
Bookkeeping never grows past its configured capacity.
The registry is non-copyable and non-movable.
concurrency: try_consume performs the full check-then-insert in one critical section, so N concurrent consumptions of one valid permit yield exactly one Ok and N-1 deterministic failures.
